_comment: check-network's record of what is allowed to answer the wire.
Same job pcall-safe.json does for 'cannot throw': the checker is only as
honest as this file, so an entry is a claim you have READ the listener and
found it non-authoritative. An observer that later starts answering a
command silently becomes a second intake with the gate's blessing.
observers          - listeners that watch traffic without executing a family
command. Exempt from the one-intake rules. Reason required.
rdnet_dispatcher   - RDNet's own listener. It IS the registry, not a tenant.
annotate           - token(s) for a listener whose filter the scanner cannot
resolve statically. Empty today; add only with the file

observers.RequiemOfTheDead/Contents/mods/RFTDCore/: Family-wide forensic sensor. Filters on nothing by design - it records every module's traffic including vanilla and third-party. Records and measures; never answers, never mutates family state. CLAUDE.md S12 observability, and the Conductor's roles table names it observe-only.
observers.RequiemOfTheDead/Contents/mods/RFTDRecla: Listens on VANILLA's 'vehicle' token, not a family token - it cannot be an intake for a family surface. Writes an audit line and a forensic record; sends nothing, mutates no world state. Note the survey flagged unescaped wire fields in its file write (RCDamageAudit.lua:78-118) - a validation item, not an intake violation.

Also on vanilla's 'vehicle' token. Attribution side effect only - stamps last-user modData so the reclamation sweep can see recent use. The survey flagged a missing proximity check (RCJanitor.lua:377-394) as an authority item; it is still not a family dispatcher.
